Archive (formerly Chats) + chat reader with Info aside
Connections (capture options, AI access, advanced collapsed)
Import dialog concept (wireframe only; MP-IMPORT-APP-01 backend supports ChatGPT and Gemini export folders/zips on plaintext legacy archives, while arbitrary transcript files remain deferred)
